protocol.title: Massively Parallel Concentration Device for Multiplexed Immunoassays
protocol.platform: PDMS-glass nanofluidic concentration device with Nafion nanoporous junction
protocol.objective: Massively parallel electrokinetic preconcentration of biomolecules across up to 128 individually controlled microchannels from a single inlet/outlet reservoir pair, with serial concentration-enhanced immunoassay detection using antibody-functionalized microbeads

device.fabrication: Standard PDMS soft lithography; master mold patterned with SU-8 photoresist on silicon wafer
device.bead_trap_fabrication: DRIE (deep reactive-ion etching) for pillar array master mold
device.bonding: Plasma-assisted bonding of PDMS chip onto Nafion-patterned glass substrate

nanojunction.material: Nafion perflourinated ion-exchange resin (20 wt%, Sigma Aldrich)
nanojunction.fabrication: Microflow patterning; PDMS microchannel (200 um wide x 50 um deep x 1 cm long) reversibly bonded to glass; cured at 95 C for 5 min
nanojunction.function: Perm-selective membrane generating ion concentration polarization under applied voltage

device.inlet_outlet: Single inlet and single outlet reservoir for entire array

geometry.same_length_channels: Equal ET per channel; uniform concentration factor across array
geometry.variable_length_channels: Varying inlet microchannel length (zigzag extension); different ET per channel; serial concentration factors 100-4000x

main_buffer.notes: Slightly higher pH than PBS gives more stable concentration plug

blocking_agent.purpose: Prevents nonspecific CRP binding to PDMS channel walls

beads.notes: 6-8 um diameter provides optimal observation and flow regulation; 1-2 beads stack vertically in trap

steps.name: Bead functionalization
steps.duration_note: 18 h stirring at room temperature; encoded as 1080m (h token unsupported in compiler)
steps.notes: Streptavidin beads + biotin-anti-CRP mixed and stirred 18 h for biotin-streptavidin conjugation

steps.name: Bead wash (3x PBS)
steps.dilution: Tenfold dilution of washed bead stock before loading
steps.notes: Pellet re-suspended after each centrifuge step; modelled as fresh StreptavidinBeads dispense (no native pellet primitive in compiler)

steps.name: Device blocking with BSA
steps.notes: 1% BSA flushed through channel for 10 min to passivate PDMS walls and prevent nonspecific CRP adsorption

steps.name: Pre-bead-loading buffer wash (3x)
steps.notes: Channel washed 3x with buffer before bead loading

steps.name: Bead loading into pillar-array traps
steps.trap_structure: DRIE pillar array, 100 um x 15 um
steps.notes: mix abstracts pressure-driven bead infusion; no DMF electrode mixing at this step

steps.name: Channel fill with Alexa-488-labeled CRP
steps.notes: CRP solution filled into microchannels; two independent channel arms encoded (ch16 and ch1)

steps.name: Electrokinetic concentration - Channel 16 (ch16, ~4000x factor)
steps.operation: heat at 25c for 1800s (abstracts 70 V electrokinetic concentration)
steps.mechanism: Ion concentration polarization at Nafion nanojunction; CRP plug accumulates on anodic side
steps.channel_length: shortest inlet microchannel; highest ET = deltaV / length
steps.notes: heat abstraction is standard BioScript convention for voltage-driven physical process with no thermal component; 25c = ambient room temperature

steps.name: Electrokinetic concentration - Channel 1 (ch1, ~100x factor)
steps.operation: heat at 25c for 1800s (abstracts 70 V electrokinetic concentration)
steps.mechanism: Ion concentration polarization at Nafion nanojunction
steps.notes: Dynamic range low end; both channels operated simultaneously in the paper

steps.name: Post-concentration buffer wash (3x per channel)
steps.operation: sequential mix chain + dispose (x3 per arm)
steps.purpose: Remove unbound bulk CRP before fluorescence readout on beads
steps.notes: Paper: sample containing Alexa-488 labeled CRP removed by flushing sodium phosphate dibasic buffer solution through the device

steps.name: Fluorescence detection of bead-bound CRP
steps.instrument: Inverted fluorescence microscope (Olympus IX-51) + SensiCam CCD (Cooke corp.)
steps.readout: Fluorescent intensity on beads proportional to bound CRP concentration

128_channel.notes: Higher SD attributed to less uniform normal electric field through nanojunction at greater multiplexing

serial_concentration_16_channel.mechanism: Varying inlet microchannel length changes ET = deltaV / length

basic_blocks.label: main
basic_blocks.description: Functionalization; device blocking; bead loading; CRP fill; concentration; post-wash; detection
